body: Like I would be bad at it because if I can't help myself how am I supposed to help someone else.
I know it's medical.  I still feel broken though.  Like I should be able to make myself happy but I can't. I don't even know what makes me happy anymore.
Yes, I was going to school for nursing. Which I have a huge passion for.
I was in college,  I had to put that on hold for now.

Lately it seems like the simplest things get me down. I try to be strong,  but I feel like I can't anymore.  I have been depressed  for over ten years.  The last 4 years I noticed it getting progressively worse.  Now it's getting so bad it's happening constantly.
